name: creator-contract-redline
description: A skill for redlining creator and influencer contracts on the creator's behalf. Not legal advice.

plugins.name: creator-contract-redline
plugins.description: Redline an influencer, creator or talent contract against a fixed mutuality checklist — indemnity, liability, termination, usage, exclusivity, payment terms — applying every edit as a tracked change so the creator never has to open the document. Includes a completeness gate that reconstructs the accept-all and reject-all versions to prove nothing was dropped. Not legal advice; no attorney-client relationship.
